description: This file contains template classes and helper functions for bitset operations, including a fast iterator to scan for set bits, as part of the ANGLE project.

classes.name: BitSetT
classes.description: Template class implementing a fixed-size bitset with various bitwise operations and iteration capabilities.

classes.name: IterableBitSet
classes.description: Specialized bitset class with an iterator for traversing set bits.

classes.name: BitSet64
classes.description: Alias for a 64-bit bitset, enabled on 64-bit CPUs.

methods.name: Bit
methods.description: Creates a bitmask with a single bit set at position x.

methods.name: operator&
methods.description: Bitwise AND operator for two BitSetT objects.

methods.name: operator|
methods.description: Bitwise OR operator for two BitSetT objects.

methods.name: operator^
methods.description: Bitwise XOR operator for two BitSetT objects.
